steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow used by the case.
Enable the tenant setting required for Last Purchase Price savings.
Set the event type to RFQ and award the entire lot to one vendor.
Provide the mandatory event title so the event can be published and found.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is rendered.
Add the CYLINDER product and set the requested quantity to 10.
Populate the remaining required pricing-sheet fields before editing the specified delivery location.
Choose the delivery location required by the case.
Confirm the selected product is the requested CYLINDER item.
Confirm the product's variant auto-filled as Variant 1.
Confirm the requested quantity was retained as 10.

args.goal: open the Savings configuration, choose Last Purchase Price for the product, save the configuration, and stop when the saved savings configuration is visible

steps.note: Configure the LPP savings basis, which has no dedicated domain step.
Publish the configured RFQ event.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Submit a vendor bid so savings and Price Trends have bid data to calculate.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Close the bidding window so Master QCS and post-bid analytics are available.
Open Master QCS after bidding has closed, as required by the case.
Navigate to the Price Trends view where the savings basis is expected to be shown.
Confirm Price Trends exposes Last Purchase Price as the savings basis.
